label.en: Backbone-conditioned MPNN: generate candidate sequences conditioned on a backbone.

label.en: MPNN plus FastRelax: combine sequence sampling and structural relaxation; computational scores need independent evaluation.

acceptance.zh: 新增由记录生成的工作流清单；对应提交的检查通过后已合并。
acceptance.en: A generated workflow checklist was added and merged after checks passed for its corresponding commit.

validation.zh: 已核对实际合并和 CI 记录；本轮没有独立复演生产流程。
validation.en: Actual merge and CI records were checked; the production workflow was not independently replayed in this snapshot.

next_step.zh: 持续核对证据缺失、阻塞和下一步的展示是否与原记录一致。
next_step.en: Keep checking that missing evidence, blockers and next actions agree with the underlying records.

acceptance.zh: 已核对实际合并记录与两处源代码变更；本次未独立复验作者报告的离线测试。
acceptance.en: The actual merge record and two-file source change were checked; the author-reported offline tests were not independently repeated here.

constraints.zh: 只报告固定字段是否存在及 JSON 类型，不输出字段值；合并不能证明部署或实际环境正常。
constraints.en: Report only fixed-field presence and JSON types, without field values; a merge does not establish deployment or operational health.

goal.en: Distinguish a non-object document from missing required fields so schema errors are easier to locate.
goal.zh: 区分非对象文档与必需字段缺失，让结构错误更容易定位。

next_step.zh: 独立核对异常输入和诊断输出边界；部署及实际环境行为仍待各自验证。
next_step.en: Independently check malformed inputs and diagnostic output boundaries; deployment and real-environment behavior still need separate verification.

validation.zh: 该提交的远程检查、状态上下文与工作流运行记录均为零；无上下文的 pending 不代表通过或失败。
validation.en: The head has zero remote check runs, status contexts and workflow runs; pending with no contexts establishes neither success nor failure.

goal.zh: 让设计、验证和交付工具更容易被发现，并保持清晰的职责边界。
goal.en: Make design, validation and delivery tools easier to find while keeping their responsibilities clear.

constraints.zh: 合并状态只指工具职责重组的源码集成；各科学工具的适用性和现场服务验收仍须分别核对。
constraints.en: Merged refers only to source integration of tool responsibilities; scientific applicability and live service acceptance require their own checks.

acceptance.zh: 源码实现已合入主线；此处不把合并视为新的预测、实验或完整平台运行验收。
acceptance.en: The source implementation is merged into main; this does not establish a new prediction, experiment or complete platform runtime acceptance.

validation.zh: 实现已合入；这是工程集成记录，不代表新的科学结果或所有服务已通过现场验收。
validation.en: The implementation is merged. This records engineering integration, not a new scientific result or live acceptance of every service.

next_step.zh: 继续按各工具的资格条件检查实际使用，保留原有失败与限制。
next_step.en: Check actual use against each tool’s qualification conditions and retain earlier failures and limits.

goal.zh: 在存储或数据库中断后，保留证据并让定期监测能够明确恢复或报错。
goal.en: Preserve evidence through storage or database interruptions and make scheduled monitoring recover or fail visibly.

constraints.zh: 恢复与备份需要真实回读；候选方案仍未集成。
constraints.en: Recovery and backups require real readback; the proposed change remains unintegrated.

acceptance.zh: 确认恢复、备份和故障路径均有证据，再评估上线。
acceptance.en: Evaluate rollout after recovery, backup and failure paths have supporting evidence.

validation.zh: 变更说明记录了实现和一次恢复演练；未据此宣称长期运行已验证。
validation.en: The change describes an implementation and a restore exercise; this does not establish long-term operational reliability.

next_step.zh: 核对独立检查与部署条件，保留失败时的诊断信息。
next_step.en: Reconcile independent checks and deployment conditions while retaining failure diagnostics.

goal.zh: 为后续性质预测研究准备可追溯的数据收集方案。
goal.en: Prepare a traceable data collection plan for later property-prediction research.

constraints.zh: 目前只有待定登记和收集计划，没有可用数据、训练模型或合格基准。
constraints.en: Only a pending registration and collection plan exist; no usable dataset, fitted model or qualified benchmark is delivered.

acceptance.zh: 先确认来源、单位和适用范围，再决定能否进行数值实验。
acceptance.en: Qualify sources, units and applicability before deciding whether numerical experiments may proceed.

validation.zh: 已检查元数据结构；数据内容、完整质量检查与独立接受仍缺失。
validation.en: Metadata structure was checked; data contents, full quality checks and independent acceptance remain missing.

next_step.zh: 保留为公开计划，等待合规的数据来源与后续确认。
next_step.en: Keep this as an open proposal pending qualified source data and further confirmation.

goal.zh: 在工具迁移与中断重试中保留原始检查义务和已接受的数据。
goal.en: Preserve original check obligations and accepted data through tool migrations and interrupted retries.

constraints.zh: 范围限于保留检查历史和中断续传的工程实现；不据此声明全部服务已部署或科学资格已成立。
constraints.en: Scope is the engineering implementation for retaining check history and interrupted publication; it does not establish deployment of all services or scientific qualification.

acceptance.zh: 保留历史检查与续传的源码实现已合入；每个后续使用仍须按其实际输入和原始结果独立验收。
acceptance.en: Source changes for retained checks and resumable publication are merged; each later use still requires acceptance against its actual inputs and original results.

validation.zh: 迁移与续传实现已合入，保留历史检查及失败记录；不据此宣称科学资格或服务部署完成。
validation.en: Migration and resumable publication changes are merged with historical checks and failures retained; this does not establish scientific qualification or service deployment.

next_step.zh: 在后续迁移中继续核对来源、续传位置和最终内容。
next_step.en: Continue checking provenance, resume positions and final content in later migrations.

goal.zh: 让客户端在重试或恢复前找回原请求身份与原始执行证据。
goal.en: Let clients recover original request identity and execution evidence before retrying or resuming.

constraints.zh: 证据不完整时保留未知状态，不能自动重复提交。
constraints.en: Retain an unknown state when evidence is incomplete and avoid automatic duplicate submissions.

acceptance.zh: 请求身份、返回产物和恢复路径都核对一致后，再考虑集成。
acceptance.en: Consider integration after request identity, returned artifacts and recovery paths agree.

validation.zh: 草稿已有实现与离线测试，但仍保留失败、未执行检查和资格缺口。
validation.en: The draft includes implementation and offline tests while retaining failures, unexecuted checks and qualification gaps.

next_step.zh: 补齐缺失验证，保持恢复与新执行的边界清晰。
next_step.en: Resolve missing validation while keeping recovery distinct from a new execution.

title.zh: 明确保留两个日历边界

goal.en: Distinguish a completed Beijing workday from a genuinely partial UTC activity snapshot.
goal.zh: 区分已结束的北京工作日与真实的UTC部分活动观察。

constraints.zh: 已发布的是区分两种日历的正文与展示；预测待完成，原有模型授权和原生结果验收要求不变。
constraints.en: Publication covers the text and calendar-boundary display; predictions remain pending and existing model authorization and native-result acceptance requirements remain in force.

acceptance.zh: 真实发布回执确认十月十九日正文已于十月二十日发布，完整预测周期尚未验收。
acceptance.en: An actual publication receipt confirms the October 19 text was published on October 20; the complete prediction cycle is not accepted.

validation.zh: 公开正文已发布，图表区分上海工作日与 UTC 日期；该日结构与性质预测仍待完成。
validation.en: The text is published and charts distinguish the Shanghai workday from UTC dates; structure and property predictions for that day remain pending.

next_step.zh: 保留预测待完成标记，待可核对的原始结果到来后再补充。
next_step.en: Retain prediction-pending labels and add results only when their original evidence can be checked.

title.zh: 区分比较证据与展示视图

goal.en: Keep comparison context explicit while showing compact views and preserving access to full records.
goal.zh: 明确保留比较背景，提供紧凑展示，同时保留完整记录入口。

constraints.zh: 已核对源码合并；本次未独立重放其记录的验收，不能据此证明分子活性或全部候选流程。
constraints.en: Source integration is verified. Recorded validation is not independently replayed here and proves neither molecular activity nor every proposal-bearing flow.

acceptance.zh: 相关源码改动与结项记录归并为一项任务，省略私有项目与实验细节。
acceptance.en: Related source changes and their closure record are merged as one task; private project and experiment details are omitted.

validation.zh: 结项记录报告了接口、渲染和浏览器检查，并保留未覆盖路径及历史失败；本次仅复核该记录和合并元数据。
validation.en: The closure record reports API, rendering and browser checks with explicit unexercised paths and retained failures; only that record and merge metadata were reviewed here.

next_step.zh: 保留来源与限制，按各自声明的背景评价新案例。
next_step.en: Retain provenance and limitations; evaluate new cases within their own declared context.
